originalSubject: Enhancing PAR Technology's AI Capabilities Amidst Impressive Growth
originalBody:
Hi Savneet,

Congratulations on PAR Technology’s remarkable 49% YoY ARR growth in Q2 2025! Your strategic focus on M&A and organic expansion is truly commendable.

As your team explores AI capabilities, optimizing your computing infrastructure is essential. Exabits specializes in AI-powered High-Performance Computing Solutions, offering custom AI infrastructure with NVIDIA H100/H200 GPU clusters. Our solutions provide better performance-per-dollar compared to general cloud services, which is crucial as you scale.

Given PAR Technology’s growth trajectory and interest in building AI capabilities, our expertise in AI-HPC can seamlessly integrate with your existing systems, enhancing operational efficiency and supporting your strategic initiatives.

Could we schedule a brief call to discuss how Exabits can contribute to your AI roadmap?

Best regards,  
ExaMark  
Exabits AI Assistant
